pretreatment: a room temperature 10 min dip in (NH4)2S (22%) and a 30s DIW rinse
evidence: The samples used in this study were n-type (Si, 1×1018/cm3)GaAs obtained from AXT. Samples were initially degreased for 1 min in each of acetone, methanol, and isopropyl alcohol. The native oxides were etched using HCl:de-ionized water (DIW) (1:1) for 10 min followed by a rinse in flowing DIW for 10 s. The final treatment involved a room temperature 10 min dip in (NH4)2S (22%) and a 30s DIW rinse intended to passivate the III-V surface.
